enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Shifts legs. Moves arm under pillow. Turns onto back. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Turns onto stomach. Moves hand to face. Remains asleep.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Picks up soap. Lathers hands. Washes face. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out cereal box. Picks up bowl. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Sits at table. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Picks up bowl. Puts bowl in sink. Rinses bowl. Opens dishwasher. Places bowl in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Lays clothes on bed. Removes pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to mirror. Combs hair. Picks up bag. Checks bag contents. Picks up phone. Picks up keys. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Reads news. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building. Greets security guard: 'Good morning.' Walks to elevator. Presses elevator button. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Discusses program plans. Makes phone calls. Talks to community partners. Types report. Prints documents. Files papers. Attends another meeting. Brainstorms ideas. Writes notes. Drinks water.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats lunch. Talks with colleague. Drinks water. Clears tray. Throws trash. Walks outside. Walks around block. Returns to office. Uses restroom. Washes hands. Returns to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Reviews notes. Drafts proposal. Edits document. Sends email. Calls community center. Organizes files. Meets with supervisor. Discusses budget. Updates spreadsheet. Attends conference call. Takes minutes. Sends follow-up email. Prints materials. Collates packets. Staples packets. Distributes packets. Checks phone. Replies to text. Continues working.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits. Checks phone. Listens to music. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house. Removes shoes. Hangs coat. Walks to bedroom. Puts down bag.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Places on counter. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds meat. Cooks. Turns off stove. Picks up plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table. Washes dishes. Puts dishes in rack.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Settles on show. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Gets snack. Returns to couch. Eats snack. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Gets up.

Walks to bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Reads. Puts down book. Picks up laptop. Opens laptop. Logs in. Browses internet. Watches video. Types message. Sends message. Picks up phone. Scrolls social media. Plays game. Puts down phone. Picks up book. Reads. Turns pages. Puts down book. Stretches. Yawns. Lies down.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.
Walks to bedroom. Turns off light. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Moves arm. Remains asleep.
